notes: HEURISTIC: contribution labels are NOT rigorous PL intersection numbers. They use Im(Phi) proximity to 0 (mod 2π), conjugate pairing, and Stokes proximity as proxies. Full rigorous thimble tracing is not implemented.
Branch cut for (-c)^{1/2^q} placed on negative real axis (numpy default).
Im(Phi) values are not reduced mod 2π in the saddle list; raw values are reported.
Stokes pairs listed are only those flagged near_stokes=True.
